## Summary

I added a `namesakeCount` field to the create-owner flow that records how many existing owners already shared the same first + last name (case-insensitive) at creation time.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer property to the `Owner` schema (regenerates into `OwnerDto`; MapStruct maps it by name automatically).

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — Wired the new `countNamesakes` step between `build` and `assignCustomerCode`, under the same `transaction` governance.

The `Cp13Tests` acceptance test (two owners with the same name → second owner reads back `namesakeCount = 1`) passes, and all pre-existing tests remain green.
